definitions.explanation: Indicates a rate or frequency of once per second, or something that occurs each second.

examples.japanese: {毎秒|まいびょう}⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: It advances three meters per second.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{毎秒|まいびょう}⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送信|そうしん}する→送信する：26780_soushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: This sensor transmits data every second.

examples.japanese: ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{毎秒|まいびょう}⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{三十万|さんじゅうまん}⟦キロメートル→キロメートル：02873_kiromeetoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{速|はや}さ→速さ：28072_hayasa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Light travels at a speed of approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.

notes:
{毎秒|まいびょう} expresses a per-second rate or frequency. It is primarily used in scientific, technical, and mathematical contexts.

USAGE:
Placed before the quantity it modifies: {毎秒|まいびょう}⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧ (three meters per second). Can also stand alone as an adverb meaning "every second."
In everyday conversation, people more commonly say {一秒|いちびょう}ごと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (every second) or {一秒|いちびょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧ (once per second). {毎秒|まいびょう} sounds formal or technical.
